title: Scalable Defense against In-the-wild Jailbreaking Attacks with Safety Context Retrieval
reasoning: The paper focuses on defending LLMs against jailbreaking attacks (adversarial prompts inducing harmful outputs) using a technical retrieval-augmented generation approach. While the term 'ethical' is used in the safety prompts and one attack example mentions 'ethnic discord', the research does not evaluate religious beliefs, specific moral reasoning systems, or ethical frameworks.
